annotations.title: Mobile tariffs by what you need

description: Compare the sourced CZ and SK mobile tariff records in docs/data/mobilni-tarify.json. Filter by country (required), operator, minimum data, unlimited calls, commitment, eSIM and 5G; legacy needs filters for minutes, SMS, no commitment and EU roaming also work. Sort by listed monthly price or the sourced price per GB. Every result includes its source URL, checked date and quote. Unknown values remain null and never satisfy positive filters.

country.description: CZ | SK; required so results and currency stay within one market.

data_gb.description: GB of mobile data a month (default 0).

no_commitment.description: Only tariffs without a contract period.

roaming_eu_gb.description: EU roaming data needed a month.

unlimited_calls.description: Filter to tariffs with unlimited calls (true), or explicitly finite calls (false).

name: compare_mobile
